it.txt: Era vice-prefeito e tomou posse como prefeito em 02/04/2026, no plenário da Câmara Municipal, depois que Rodrigo Medeiros renunciou ao cargo, em 01/04/2026, para concorrer a deputado estadual na eleição de 2026.
it.txt_en: He was vice mayor and was sworn in as mayor on April 2, 2026, in the City Council chamber, after Mayor Rodrigo Medeiros resigned on April 1, 2026, to run for state deputy in the 2026 election.
